subject: Permit expiring soon — {referenceNumber} {title} closes at {expiredAt} UTC
preheader: An open permit on {productName} reaches the end of its validity window within the hour.
body: The {typeName} permit "{title}" ({referenceNumber}){siteLine} reaches the end of its validity window at {expiredAt} UTC. If the work is finished, close the permit with the close-out checks now. If it must continue, extend it with re-authorisation before the window lapses — once it expires, work is no longer authorised.
footer: You are receiving this because you are a signature party (issuer, acceptor or authoriser) on this permit in {productName}.
